name: Bandit Captain

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The captain makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Dagger in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it, provided it can see the attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

description: A bandit captain leads their gang with equal parts charisma and cruelty, quick to talk their way past trouble and quicker still to cut down anyone who calls the bluff.
